column1: # ── INPUT (Gate-1, you edit) — authoritative SHA->category map: <sha> <category> [decision]. '#' = comment. See ../README.md ──
# reviewer-applied by spectro-capx-upgrade:capi-plan-reviewer — stops two silent auto-PICKs.
# Category F4 routes the commit to NEEDS-DECISION + a Regression-Watch row (engine
# capi-commit-reconcile.sh: `elif [ "$cat" = "F4" ]`), which is the correct state for both:
# a human must decide, and neither may be auto-picked.
# e0764bbd / e2bc5177 — the spectro/ MANIFEST tree (spectro/generated/core-global.yaml alone is
# ~6k lines of CAPI-v1.9-era CRDs + webhook config, plus spectro/core/{base,global} kustomize
# overlays and spectro/run.sh). The plan auto-PICKed both as "fork-only [confidence=heuristic]"
# because conf GENERATED_PATHS says `spectro/base|spectro/global` while the real paths are
# `spectro/core/base`, `spectro/core/global`, `spectro/generated` — so the generated-artifact
# detector never fired. Cherry-picking v1beta1-era generated CRDs onto a v1beta2 base is a
# guaranteed stale-manifest regression, and Spec Patch F says these artifacts are REGENERATED
# (palette vendorcrd-sync), never cherry-picked. NOT marked REGEN here because palette's
# cmd/vendorcrd-sync/providers.yaml currently has NO `vsphere` provider entry, so there is no
# working regeneration path yet — a human must choose: add vsphere to providers.yaml and drop
# spectro/ from the fork, or carry spectro/ forward and regenerate it in-fork.
# The durable fix is to correct GENERATED_PATHS in conf/capi-upgrade.conf (outside reviewer scope).
# NOTE: column 3 is the DECISION (engine ALLOWED_DEC), not a free-text note — keep notes in comments.
e0764bbd
# 9767d35a — MANDATORY, not merely diverged. It flips the --webhook-port default 9443 -> 0 and
# gates webhook-setup vs controller-setup on that port. palette cmd/vendorcrd-sync/providers.yaml
# documents the deployment as depending on exactly this ("the fork's main.go split", global bucket
# = webhook-only :9443, base bucket = --webhook-port=0 controller-only). conf MANDATORY_PATTERNS
# ("exclusive webhook") does not match this subject, so it was classified F4? and buried among the
# other NEEDS-DECISION rows. Pinned F4 so it can never become a silent auto-PICK if the conflict
# clears on a re-plan; it needs a deliberate resolve, and it must not be dropped.
